blurb: Guests participate in private escape room experiences lasting 60 minutes, with a total visit time of about 90 minutes. Groups of 2-8 players solve puzzles and find clues to escape before time runs out. All rooms have unlocked exit doors and are family-friendly, with adjustments for age and experience.
extraNote: All tickets are non-refundable · Cancellation requests must be emailed at least 72 hours in advance · Same-day changes incur a $50 fee · Late arrivals may lose game time or forfeit session and payment · Each booking can be rescheduled once only · No refunds for late arrivals
